prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept production game UI icon
Asset type: exactly one compact Power-status emblem for a 256x256 fantasy card-game consumer

Consumer contract:
The same single icon is consumed for both the normal and large Infinite Canvas Power display. It represents every Attack that actually restores life through Drain permanently increasing future Drain. The complete emblem must remain immediately readable at 64x64 and 32x32 through one continuous infinity-loop silhouette, progressive color growth, and one central life core.

Primary request:
Draw exactly one centered, compact, ornate magical infinity-canvas emblem. Form one continuous horizontal infinity symbol as a substantial Mobius-like picture frame with broad interwoven bands and a clear crossing at the center. Along the loop, arrange a small sequence of discrete enamel color panels that progress from deep blue through violet and magenta into bright gold, becoming visibly brighter and richer step by step as they return around the endless path. Set one dominant faceted life crystal precisely at the central crossing, white-blue at its heart with restrained violet and gold facets. The frame, color panels, and life crystal must join into one coherent solid emblem.

Topology and style:
Use one unified infinity-loop silhouette with thick dark-indigo outlines, near-opaque flat enamel fills, broad blue-purple-magenta-gold planes, crisp hard edges, restrained gold trim, and only minimal hard-edged highlights contained inside the material forms. The two loop lobes must be large and unmistakable, while the central life crystal remains the strongest focal point. Use chunky geometry and a limited number of discrete color blocks so the progressive growth remains readable at tiny size.

Composition:
Exactly one emblem, centered. The complete solid emblem occupies approximately 58 percent of the image width and 48 percent of the image height. Keep wide, even, completely empty safety space on all four sides. Render nothing beyond the compact material silhouette.

Constraints:
Exactly one continuous infinity or Mobius frame, one central life crystal, and one clearly ordered progression of discrete color panels. No brush, palette knife, pen, wand, staff, sword, weapon-like implement, person, character, face, mouth, lips, teeth, hand, body part, creature, text, letters, numbers, equations, formulae, pseudo-glyphs, logo, signature, watermark, card, panel, sprite sheet, or multiple-view layout. No blood, crimson liquid, red liquid, droplets, splashes, wounds, gore, mouth-adjacent strand, mouth-adjacent ribbon, or mouth-emitted magic. No halo, aura, bloom, mist, haze, fog, smoke, shadow, ambient light, particles, dust, sparks, stardust, rays, projected light, translucent fringe, gradient spill, elongated trail, detached ornament, or low-opacity mark outside the solid emblem. Do not let any part of the emblem touch an image edge.
